title: VU1 EATAN series constant had a dropped digit (-0.13085337519646 vs -0.139085337519646)
problem: Fourth EATAN series coefficient mistyped; EATAN/EATANxy/EATANxz results off by up to ~0.008 near t = 1.
approach: Use PCSX2 _vuCalculateEATAN's constant; the other seven constants already matched it digit for digit.

title: VIFn register reads returned the raw I/O map, not the VIF state
problem: readIORegister served VIF0/VIF1 STAT, ERR, MARK, CODE, ITOPS... from m_ioRegisters, so a guest never saw INT/VIS/MRK/DBF set by the VIF interpreter; VIF0_FBRST/ERR and VIF1_ERR writes were ignored. The debug panel also labelled MARK (0x30) as ERR.
approach: Reads come from vif0_regs/vif1_regs; ERR and VIF0_FBRST writes handled; only FDR is writable in VIF1_STAT; debug panel offsets fixed.
scope_evidence: Any guest that polls VIFn_STAT (PCSX2 notes Yakuza does)
